global_rules.rollout: autonomous after the provided conditioning prefix; no teacher forcing in scored frames
global_rules.normalization: fit on train split only and publish constants
global_rules.aggregation: publish per-case values; headline is macro average over cases, then families
global_rules.missingness: never encode missing particles or predictions as physical zeros
global_rules.uncertainty: report each seed and bootstrap confidence intervals over cases; do not treat frames as independent samples
global_rules.comparability: metrics outside a case's validation_scope are diagnostic, not benchmark truth
